lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: Greetings.

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: This is the ninja thief,

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: newly assigned to the Thieves of Justice as a trainee.

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: I am reporting to you

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: and humbly await your guidance.
You're talking like we've never met.

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: This is the first time I'm speaking with you

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: as the ninja thief, Commander.

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: Therefore, I am greeting you anew.
Is that why you changed your profile pic too?

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: Affirmative.

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: Since I am conducting this BlaBla chat as a ninja thief,

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: my profile picture must also reflect this.
You're really going all out.

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: That is correct.

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: This is my first time participating in this kind of mission,

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: so I remain vigilant at all times.

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: Only by doing so can I avoid troubling my seniors.

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: I humbly ask for your guidance moving forward.
Yeah, same here.

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: But I have a question.

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: May I use the equipment in the Observatory

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: for my Phantom Thief missions?

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: If I can make use of radar or radio towers,

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: I can execute them more efficiently.
Yeah... I don't think that's possible.

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: Hmm, I am curious as to the reason.

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: I would appreciate it if you could tell me.
Using equipment that big makes it impossible to move stealthily.
Using the Outpost's equipment for your phantom thief missions can cause problems.

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: You are absolutely correct, Commander.

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: In thinking about how to excel at phantom thief missions,

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: I neglected a crucial fact that

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: a Phantom Thief must remain concealed.

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: Indeed,

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: I am not yet ready to become a full-fledged phantom thief.

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: I must continue my training diligently.
All right, give it your best.

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: I wish to become a proper Phantom Thief

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: who can stand alongside my seniors as soon as possible.

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: To that end, I must increase my training.

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: Thank you for your guidance.
